The organization provides comprehensive primary care, dental, behavioral health, pharmacy, and lab services to over 40,000 patients annually, predominantly low-income, uninsured, and Medicaid populations.

company_icp: Underserved populations in Central Florida including low-income, uninsured, and Medicaid patients of all ages seeking affordable primary and specialty healthcare services.

company_description: Community Access Network is a Federally Qualified Health Center (FQHC) in Virginia that provides affordable primary and preventive care services to underserved, underinsured, and uninsured patients regardless of their ability to pay. The organization serves patients with complex medical issues and offers a reduced fee program for those with high-deductible insurance plans. With approximately 73 employees, the clinic provides comprehensive services including primary medical care, pediatrics, gynecology, dental, behavioral health, and chronic condition management.
company_offer: Community Access Network delivers comprehensive healthcare services including primary medical care, pediatrics, gynecology, dental services, behavioral health, chronic condition management, sexual health services, and same-day walk-in care. They also provide benefit programs, support services, and a reduced fee program for qualifying patients.
company_icp: Underserved and underinsured patient populations in Virginia, including those with complex medical issues, patients without insurance, and individuals qualifying for reduced-fee care. The organization serves as a safety-net provider regardless of patients' ability to pay.
company_painpoint: As an FQHC handling sensitive patient data and ePHI, Community Access Network faces HIPAA compliance obligations and data integrity requirements for patient records. With limited resources (73 employees) and diverse service lines, they likely struggle with lightweight IT deployment, compliance monitoring across multiple service categories, and ensuring EHR/EMR system integrity while maintaining operational efficiency across their clinic operations.
